name: Sessionboard
description: Sessionboard lets event organizers work with their speaker and session data in Claude. Ask natural-language questions about sessions, speakers, contacts, and evaluations (answered through Sessionboard’s SbQL query engine), search and cite specific events and sessions, run reports and analytics dashboards, and manage the event workspace — creating and updating sessions, contacts, exhibitors, sponsors, agenda drafts, and scheduling rules — all scoped to your own organization with OAuth sign-in.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sessionboard to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sessionboard to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sessionboard.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sessionboard MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sessionboard lists 38 MCP tools, including execute_sbql, fetch, find_event, get_contact, get_event_overview, get_schema, get_session, get_suggestions, get_widget_schema, list_contacts, list_draft_sessions, and list_event_reports.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sessionboard?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Sessionboard in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Sessionboard requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sessionboard is developed by Sessionboard. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
